description: Backend Service client for the FHIRFrog conformance test runner on the aucore node. Register with: python scripts/register_smart_client.py --bulk --clients-file module-config/fhirfrog-clients.json --node aucore
notes: Partition access is FHIRFROG only, deliberately NOT 'FHIRFROG,DEFAULT'. Smile CDR's FHIR_ACCESS_PARTITION_NAME gates reads and writes together, and the consent service that would write-protect DEFAULT (ADR 0001 point 6) is not wired on any node, so a DEFAULT grant here would confer DEFAULT write. See docs/fhirfrog-tenant.md.
